rationale: Both Dhanush and Haowen are robotics founders with complementary technical depth — Dhanush brings full-stack robot perception and ROS architecture expertise across multiple geographies, while Haowen's background in visual servoing, manipulation, and low-level systems (CoreOS at Apple) addresses the computer vision and hardware layers that scale robotics products. They're mutual matches and could explore collaboration on perception-manipulation integration or share approaches to building production robotics systems.
intro_message: Dhanush Baktha, meet Haowen Shi — both robotics founders with overlapping tech stacks (Python, C++) and complementary depth in perception (Dhanush's ROS architecture) and manipulation systems (Haowen's visual servoing work at Mach9).
